Class 2 · Chapter 6 of 9

Clocks, dates and how long

Read clocks to the quarter hour, work out how long, and use a calendar.

  1. See it
  2. Try it
  3. Practise it
  4. Print it
  5. Check it

This chapter works best after Length, weight, capacity and temperature. You can still look around, or jump to the check.

By the end I can…

  • I can match a clock to a time.
  • I can work out how long something takes.
  • I can use a calendar or timetable.

1 See it

Screen 1 of 5

Read the hour hand first

The short hand tells the hour. The long hand tells the minutes.

At 4 o'clock the long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 4.

Screen 2 of 5

Quarter past

A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes.

When the long hand points to 3 it is quarter past. Here it is quarter past 7.

Screen 3 of 5

Quarter to

When the long hand points to 9, there are 15 minutes to go until the next hour.

Here it is quarter to 9. The short hand is almost on 9.

Screen 4 of 5

How long does it take?

Count the hours between the start and the end.

School starts at 9 and lunch is at 12. That is 3 hours.

Screen 5 of 5

Use a calendar

A week has 7 days. The days sit in the same column every week.

If March 8 is a Sunday, then March 15 is a Sunday too.

Words to know
quarter past
The minute hand points to 3. It is 15 minutes after the hour.
quarter to
The minute hand points to 9. It is 15 minutes before the next hour.
elapsed time
How much time passes from a start to an end.

For parents

What your child learns

A timetable lists tasks with start and end times. A task's length is the time from start to end. To go back in time, subtract the length from the clock time.

A common slip

Children may subtract hours and minutes as plain numbers. Go to the next whole hour first, or count back by hours then minutes. Check on a clock.

5-minute home activity: Make a timetable

  1. Write 3 tasks with start and finish times on paper.
  2. Find which task is the shortest.
  3. Use a clock to count minutes for one task.
  4. Choose a time and count back 1 hour 25 minutes.
